css.method: Actual local run of Wikimedia CSS parser, StylePropertySanitizer and selector grammar with the TemplateStyles rule construction used by this stylesheet. No site-specific Wikimedia hooks are loaded. Existing dependencies were read locally, fetch was blocked, no wiki was opened.

limitations: Synthetic browser data and illustrative images only.
Native Firefox and Safari were not rerun.
First long browser network log lost older events. A separate bounded reload check captured 41 requests with no gaps and no external destinations.
Public anonymous Wikifeeds documentation and sample feed were read separately for design verification. Browser tests use no Wikimedia services.
No Wikimedia installation, authenticated session, edit, upload or GitHub push occurred.
Live owner refresh changes only the screen. Visitors retain the last manually saved cover.
Edit panel controls remain local and are not wired into a live Wikipedia page.
